shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular marker at the edge of a marked interval or at a point on a plotted trace. Compare the mark at 1 on the number line on the left with the mark at 2 on the number line on the right.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The displayed interval includes its boundary value 1. Right image: The displayed interval includes its boundary value 2.
Rationales: On the left, the filled dot makes equality at 1 admissible for the interval. On the right, the filled dot makes equality at 2 admissible for the interval.
